svg.title: Output-error ellipses prefer a different lattice point
svg.desc: Quantized weight candidates form an integer lattice in two-dimensional weight space. Ellipses centered on original weights 0.49 and 0.40 are equal output-SSE contours for Gram matrix [[1,1],[1,2]]. The independent point [0,0] lies on a higher-error contour than compensated [0,1]. A path goes through the remaining-weight optimum [0,0.645].
